reviews.review: Excellent Warhammer 40k action game with incredibly fun and satisfying combat with excellent kill animations. Charge fearlessly into battle and lay waste to Greenskins and Chaos alike with powerful weapons such as the chainsword, plasma gun, and thunder hammer. I will say that the final battle is somewhat of a let down, but the experience up until that point is a hell of a lot of fun! I've played through this game multiple times just to kick some Greenskin ass!

Entertaining and fun the hours flew by as I stomped orcs and supernatural beings left and right. The more you play the better it gets due to fun upgrades and powerful weapons. The story's pace is a bit off and, while there are almost no breaks in between the fighting, the location and lore ooze out of every corner of the devastated world. The biggest drawbacks of the game however is the short lenght and linear level design.

This game really takes you to the WH40K world.  The architecture you see in the game, when you run or leap down, you feel as if you weight A LOT, the music is precise and fit for an epic campaign. Also, you can at last realize how a Space Marine feels battling unending hordes. 
If you want a full WH40K experience, I cannot think of a better game than this one and, believe me, I played a lot of them.

This is a shooter experience not quite like any other. Melee and ranged combat integrate fairly seamlessly, everything feels weighty and powerful, and there's less twitch-headshotting so much as twitch-combat. When you engage in fights, your suvival under fire lasts longer than many other shooting games, but indecision will still wipe you out.

Online community is active via groups, and the single player is certainly fun enough for a playthrough or two. Pick it up if it's cheap.

Overall i thik this game is great. i am not sure that people still play the multiplayer, but i loved the campaign. it really put some life into the characters, and it is a great game for any fan of the imperium.

pros
-ok graphics
-easy to learn controls
-puts depth into an average space marine hero

cons
-enemies are sometimes very dumb, very very dumb
-not enough weapons for my liking
-such a cliff hanger ending, i want to know what happens
